description: Prepaid booking with deposit, check-in/no-show handling, dispute windows, arbiter and backup arbiter (hotel stay escrow)

settle.agreed.description: Guest and hotel agree on how to split the money; the co-signer checks it against the policy.

refund.conceded.description: The hotel admits a problem at check-in; everything goes back to the guest.

settle.ruling.description: The arbiter rules on a dispute and signs with one party. The co-signer is not involved.

ruling.backup.description: If the arbiter misses its deadline, the backup arbiter rules, with one party and the co-signer.

default.refund.description: The hotel never confirmed in time: the guest gets the room money back automatically.

default.noshow.description: The guest never checked in and never disputed: the hotel is paid the room automatically.

default.release.description: Nobody claimed or disputed after checkout: the room goes to the hotel and the deposit back to the guest, automatically.

confirmBy.description: The hotel must confirm the booking within this time after you book.

checkInBy.description: The latest the hotel can record you as checked in, counted from the check-in time.

entryDisputeBy.description: How long you have, from the check-in time, to dispute a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room).

claimBy.description: How long the hotel has after checkout to claim against your deposit.

disputeWindowEnds.description: How long you have after checkout to dispute a claim or a problem with the stay. After this, silence counts as agreement.

rulingDueBy.description: How long the arbiter has to rule once a dispute is open. After this, the backup arbiter may rule.
